{{Quote|At the House Palace in Csilla's capital city of Csaplar can be found the Cabinet and Parliament.|Sentientologist Tem Eliss, ''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life''|<ref name="TC" />}}
The '''House Palace''' was a building located in [[Csaplar/Legends|Csaplar]], the capital city of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] on the planet [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]]. It held the [[Chiss Senate]] and the [[Cabinet (Chiss)|Cabinet]].<ref name="TC" />
